eyebrow: Git, GitHub & CI/CD for Data · Chapter 4, Lesson 17
subtitle: The pipeline's definition lives in the repository it builds

caption: One event can trigger multiple runners — each runs one job, made of ordered steps.

code:
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: dbt build
caption: on: is the event, runs-on: is the runner, test: is the job, each step runs in order.

steps.label: Reviewable
steps.sub: Shows up as a diff in a pull request

steps.label: Reproducible
steps.sub: Identical on every branch that checks it out

steps.label: Recoverable
steps.sub: git log and git revert work like any file
